subject: Sourcing plan: MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner — AegisOps on shortlist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Sourcing plan: MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner — AegisOps on shortlist

Team —

Following the renewal window coming up in July, I pulled together a short vendor shortlist and an initial sourcing approach for MDM, EDR, and our vuln scanner. Key constraints: predictable per-endpoint pricing, SOC2 evidence, and ability to run a staged rollout across Dedicated + Private fleets.

Attached: vendor-comparison-20260518.xlsx (high-level TCO + feature matrix).

Proposed next steps:
- Agree crate of functional must-haves by EOD Tue (MDM + EDR + vuln)
- Ask AegisOps for a firm price sheet and SOC2 summary (I've pinged them)
- Plan a 6-week canary (500 devices) and gating criteria (false positive rate, telemetry overhead)

Please review the spreadsheet — flag any must-have items I missed (example: offline device management, FIPS cert requirement). I want to get procurement a formal RFP by next Monday.

-J

Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, IT Security
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing plan: MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner — AegisOps on shortlist

Thanks Jonas — quick notes after skimming: 

- On the matrix, add a column for "agent memory/CPU overhead" — procurement will ask about impact on our smallest instance types.
- Add EDR telemetry retention options (30/90/365) and whether data can be routed to our internal S3 for long-term storage.
- For MDM, we need explicit macOS DEP/Apple Business Manager support listed.

I'll start drafting the RFP language for cost and SLA requirements. If AegisOps can provide a 30-day trial license for 500 devices, that would fit our canary plan.

-Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Architect, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@aegisops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aegisops.com, sales@aegisops.com
Date: 2026-05-18T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sourcing plan: MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner — AegisOps on shortlist

Hi Jonas / Marissa — great to hear from you and congrats on making us to the shortlist. Attached is a tailored proposal and a SOC 2 summary PDF. Key callouts:

- Pricing model: per-active-endpoint monthly with stepped discounts at 5k/20k/50k. We can offer a temporary canary discount of 30% for the first 60 days for up to 1,000 devices.
- Agent footprint: ~18MB RAM avg, CPU impact typically <2% on idle for our Linux/Mac builds.
- Data residency: certified to push telemetry to customer-managed S3 buckets; we support SSE-KMS.
- Trial: 30-day trial licenses available; we can deploy a pre-configured canary bundle and a playbook for rollback.

Attachments: aegisops-proposal-2026-05.pdf, aegisops-soc2-summary.pdf

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk pricing and rollout.

Best,
Sam Ellis
Enterprise Sales
AegisOps

Forwarding AegisOps proposal to procurement ops for timeline alignment.

Procurement team — can you confirm:
1) What is the minimum PO lead time for a proofs/trial license vs full contract?
2) Who should negotiate the temporary canary pricing discount vs. commercial pricing?
3) Are there any procurement docs (PO terms/Flex SLA templates) we should provide them upfront?

Tentative plan: schedule AegisOps technical walkthrough next Wed, run a 30-day canary in weeks 2-6 post-SOW, collect telemetry and cost delta, then decide on 12/24 month commit.

-J

Date: 2026-05-19T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Sourcing plan: MDM + EDR + vulnerability scanner — AegisOps on shortlist

Jonas — thanks for the forward. Procurement confirms: 

- PO lead time: Standard SOW + PO is ~3 weeks once commercial terms agreed; trial licenses typically issued within 3 business days after a signed trial MOU.
- Negotiation owner: Procurement will own commercial terms; Security (Jonas) will own technical acceptance criteria for the canary.
- Docs: I'll attach our standard vendor terms and the vendor onboarding checklist to this thread (see attached).

Next actions:
1) Procurement to send draft MOU for the 30-day canary to aegisops procurement contact (procurement@aegisops.com) by Thu EOD.
2) Security to draft the canary acceptance criteria doc (telemetry thresholds, false positive bins, CPU/memory ceiling).

Attaching: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (sent separately).

-Mina

Mina Haddad
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
